verdict.rationale: Gemini in BigQuery is a first-party assistant built into the product. The docs say it generates and suggests SQL and Python code, explains queries, and offers conversational analytics where users talk to their data in natural language. Users can also create configurable data agents, explore and visualize data with natural language in data canvas, and get automated data insights. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works in practice, and documentation of the assistant executing multi-step tasks on its own, beyond generating and suggesting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: You can create data agents configured with custom metadata, instructions, glossary terms, and verified queries
Conversational analytics lets you have natural language conversations with your data.
BigQuery의 Gemini를 사용하여 SQL 또는 Python에서 코드를 생성하거나 제안하고 기존 SQL 쿼리를 설명할 수 있습니다.
BigQuery의 Gemini로 자연어를 사용하여 테이블 애셋을 찾고 조인하고 쿼리하고 결과를 시각화하며 전체 프로세스에서 다른 사용자와 원활하게 공동작업할 수 있습니다.
Data insights offers an automated, intuitive way to uncover patterns and perform statistical analysis by using insightful queries that are generated from the metadata of your tables.
